tagline: Leading technology platform powering the world's modern markets and capital access.
hero_kpi_rationale: Nasdaq positions itself as the undisputed leader in US IPOs, capturing a significant share of raised capital and achieving its 7th consecutive year at the top, which demonstrates its centrality in capital access for businesses.

kpis.name: Listing Leadership
kpis.explanation: Nasdaq's position as the privileged exchange for US IPOs.
kpis.description: Amount of capital raised by companies (US IPO) listed on Nasdaq in 2025. Indicator tracked annually by company analysts, values tracked over the last 1 year.
kpis.signal: Leader in US IPOs for the 7th consecutive year.

kpis.name: Listing Transfers
kpis.explanation: Value of assets transferred to Nasdaq from other exchanges.
kpis.description: Annual volume of listing transfers to Nasdaq, including the largest transfer in history in 2025.

kpis.name: ETP AUM
kpis.explanation: Total assets managed by exchange-traded products (ETP) listed on Nasdaq.
kpis.description: Assets under management of ETPs at the end of 2025, reaching a historic peak of 882 billion dollars.
kpis.signal: Record level of assets under management for ETPs.

kpis.name: Index Net Inflows
kpis.explanation: Net amount of investments in Nasdaq index products.
kpis.description: Net inflows recorded by Nasdaq indices in 2025, reaching a record level of 99 billion dollars.
kpis.signal: Record net inflows for Nasdaq indices.

kpis.name: Financial Technology ARR Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth rate of Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in the Financial Technology segment.
kpis.description: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth rate for the Financial Technology segment in 2025, supported by new customer acquisition and add-on sales.
kpis.signal: Strong recurring revenue growth in financial technology.

kpis.name: Market Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by Nasdaq's market services activities, including equities and options.
kpis.description: Record revenue for the Market Services segment in 2025, supported by the strength of US equity and equity options volumes.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 31.05 billion dollars last year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 9.47 billion dollars last year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filed.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 4.277 billion dollars last year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income annually, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filed.
kpis.signal: Net income of 1.788 billion dollars last year.
